# Home page build spec

**Design reference:** https://advent.qagency.workers.dev/design/ (desktop and mobile). Switch the top bar to **Annotated** to see the build note on every section. The page source is `site/design/index.html` and the generator is `handoff/design-source/build_home.py`.

**Starting point:** `handoff/theme-draft/` has an earlier, unstyled draft of `templates/index.json`, `sections/header-group.json`, `sections/footer-group.json` and `config/settings_data.json`, generated by `make_theme.py`. It uses real Enterprise section and setting names, so it's a good base. It **predates the design**, so wherever it disagrees with this spec, this spec wins. Known differences are listed in each section below. Always check setting names against the theme's actual section schema before writing JSON.

**Kinds:** `native` = Enterprise section, settings only. `tweak` = native section + CSS (in `assets/advent.css` or the section's Custom CSS box) or a small Liquid change. `custom` = new section or app. Stay within these labels. If something marked native can't be done natively, stop and flag it.

---

## Global (theme settings, header group, footer group)

Do these first, because every section depends on them.

### Theme settings (`config/settings_data.json`)
Apply `design-tokens.md`: colours, fonts (Nunito 800 headings, DM Sans body), page width 1600, button radius 10, animations **disabled**, product cards (square ratio, contain, vendor shown, inventory shown, quick add with a full-width button at the bottom, **rating off**), cart type drawer, free shipping notice at **$300**, predictive search on with vendor and price. The draft has most of this. Change it to match the tokens (for example, the draft has the announcement on sky tint and the footer on surface-subtle, which are both outdated).

### 1. Announcement bar · `tweak`
- Left: **Flat rate shipping** $10 Sydney Metro, Gosford & Wollongong · $15 rest of Australia · **Free over $300**
- Right links: Help & FAQ (`/pages/help`), Track my order (`/account`), Brands A-Z (`/pages/brands`)
- Background #f5b06a, ink text, 13px.
- **Tweak:** a second, shorter message for mobile only: **Shipping** $10 Sydney · $15 Australia · **Free $300+**. Add it as a second text setting on the block (or a second block), shown below 900px with CSS. Utility links are hidden on mobile.

### 2. Header · `native` (+ CSS for the gradient)
- Logo left (home link): desktop `site/design/img/advent-logo.png` (60px tall). **Mobile uses the horizontal logo** `site/design/img/advent-logo-h.png` (34px tall). If Enterprise has no mobile logo setting, swap it with CSS (`tweak`).
- Search bar with the category dropdown: All / Board Games / Roleplaying / Accessories. Placeholder: "Search 11,000+ games, publishers, designers..."
- Icons: Account, Wishlist (desktop only), Cart with count.
- Sticky: native Enterprise behaviour (logo/search/icons stay, menu row tucks away on scroll down and returns on scroll up). Turn on, don't rebuild.
- **Gradient style (default):** see `design-tokens.md` > Header. Use the colour scheme gradient setting if available, otherwise section Custom CSS.
- Mobile: burger left, logo, account and cart right, full-width rounded search pill below. Match the design's sizes (logo 34px, burger 26px, icons 24px).
- Menu (`main-menu`): Preorders, Just Arrived, Board Games, Roleplaying, Accessories, Sale. **No Brands item.** Right side: Shipping & pickup, About.
- Mega menus (header blocks):
  - **Preorders:** Column layout, no images. Columns "Preorders" (New to preorder, Coming soon, All preorders, Kickstarter) and "By type" (Board games, Expansions, RPGs, Accessories). 3 promo banners: Due this month, Kickstarter pledges, How preorders work.
  - **Just Arrived:** no block (standard dropdown): New board games, New expansions, New RPGs, New accessories, Back in stock, Everything new.
  - **Board Games:** Sidebar layout. Groups: Game type, Player count, Rankings & awards, LCGs & miniatures, Collections, Expansions. The design uses **pastel icon tiles instead of photos**: alternate the six tint colours, with a large rotated line icon. If the sidebar block only takes images, upload the tiles as images (render the SVG icon on a tint) rather than building custom. Flag it if that isn't possible.
  - **Roleplaying:** Column layout, no images: Fantasy, Sci-fi, Horror & modern, Browse all, RPG accessories.
  - **Accessories:** Column layout + 3 promo banners: Protect, Upgrade, Play.
  - **Sale:** no block (standard dropdown): Weekly sale, Clearance, Dings & dents, All sale.
- Menus and collections that don't exist yet: create the **menu** items pointing at existing collections where possible, otherwise `#`. **Don't create products.** List anything missing in your report.

### 3. Trust strip · `native` (Icons with text, header group)
4 items, icon beside text: Free shipping over $300 / $10 Sydney Metro · $15 Australia-wide · Australia-wide via AusPost / Tracked, boxed and padded · Friendly, local service / You'll hear back from Dean · Secure checkout / Card, PayPal or bank transfer. Icons in 40px #e2f2f6 circles. **Mobile:** one item at a time, single line, small icon, title only, with arrows (as on the Enterprise demo).

### Footer group
- **Newsletter · `tweak`:** "New releases and preorders, first." + "New arrivals, preorders and the odd special, straight to your inbox. No spam, unsubscribe any time." Email field + Sign up. Orange-to-sun gradient. Decorative floating game-piece icons on the right (CSS/SVG, optional, keep it light).
- **Footer · `native`:** sky-to-blue gradient. Column 1: logo + "Your friendly, local, online board game store. Sydney based, shipping Australia-wide." + dean@adventgames.com.au · 0411 017 162 + Free pickup Tuesday nights, Chatswood. Columns: Shop, Help, Advent Games (menus `footer-shop`, `footer-help`, `footer-advent`; link targets are in the design). Payment icons on. **"Powered by BGG" logo bottom right** (`site/design/img/powered-by-bgg.png`). This is a condition of Dean's BGG API use, so it must be there.

## Home page sections (`templates/index.json`), top to bottom

### 1. Hero · Promo grid · `tweak`
- 1 large tile (2 x 2) + 2 small tiles, static (no rotation).
- **Large:** background image `site/design/img/hero-bg.jpg`, with a text panel on #e2f2f6 (radius 10, max-width 560): eyebrow "New site, same Dean", H1 "Welcome to the new look Advent Games!", text "Same friendly service, a much easier way to find your next game. Filter 11,000+ games by players, play time, complexity, categories, mechanics, designers, and much more!", button "Read the blog post" (primary) to `/blogs/news`.
- **Small 1:** sun (#f4d44d) fill. Eyebrow "This week", "Just arrived", link "See what's new". Box art bleeds off the bottom right, rotated -8deg (`site/design/img/abroad.jpg`). Link `/collections/just-arrived`.
- **Small 2:** #a2dded fill. Eyebrow "Reserve now", "Preorders open", link "The big December releases". Box art `site/design/img/8-dragons.jpg`. Link `/collections/preorders`.
- **Tweak:** the bleeding, rotated box art on the small tiles (CSS).
- The design also has a **Boxing Day sale** variant (top bar Hero toggle): `sale-bg.jpg`, orange "Up to 40% off · 26 Dec to 5 Jan" pill, corner "Sale on" ribbon. Build the launch version. Note in your report how Dean would switch to the sale version (a second promo grid kept hidden, or block swaps).

### 2. Find your next game · Collection list · `tweak`
- Heading "Find your next game", sub "Browse by the way you like to play."
- 8 tiles, 4 across (2 on mobile): Strategy, Family, Party, Thematic, Wargames, Solo games, Two-player, Kids, each with a one-line sub (see the design).
- **Tweak:** no images. Coloured tint tiles with a big rotated line icon top right and the title bottom left. Colours alternate blue, sun, orange, sky, muted, orange, sky, green tints. CSS on the collection list section. Icons as inline SVG from `handoff/design-source/common.py` (`I()` paths).
- Note: Steph is getting a quote for custom illustrations here. Build the icon version for now.

### 3. Just arrived · Featured collection · `native`
"Just arrived" / "Fresh off the truck and ready to ship from Sydney." / View all. Collection `just-arrived`. Carousel, 5 across on desktop, arrows, no autoplay.

### 4. New to preorder · Featured collection · `native`
"New to preorder" / "Charged now, shipped the day they land. Cancel any time before they leave our supplier." / "All preorders". Collection `new-to-preorder`. Surface-subtle band (#f6f8fa).

### 5. Coming soon · Featured collection · `native`
"Coming soon" / "On the way from our suppliers, with a due date. Preorder now to lock in your copy." / "All coming soon". Collection `coming-soon`.

### 6. Best sellers · Featured collection · `native`
"Best sellers" / "The games our customers keep coming back for." / View all. Collection `best-sellers` (automated, best-selling sort).

### 7. Staff recommendations · Product list · `tweak`
"Staff recommendations" / "What have we been playing this week?" / "All staff picks". 4 manually picked products, grid 4 across. Sun tint band (#fcf3cc). **Tweak:** each card shows `advent.staff_note` inset inside the card below the button (quote style, "Dean, Advent Games" byline). Hidden when the note is empty. The draft's product handles may not exist: use any 4 demo products.

### 8. New to board games? · Media with text · `native`
Image left (`site/design/img/beginners.jpg`), eyebrow "Start here", H2 "New to board games?", Dean's copy: "Every journey begins with a single step, and these collections will set you on the Board Game path. These games provide a strong base for learning essential board game mechanics, and are great fun for nearly all ages!" Buttons: Gateway games (primary), Family games, Two-player (secondary). 24px gap between text and buttons.

### 9. Gift cards · Media with text · `native`
Text left, image right (`site/design/img/giftcard-email.jpg`). Eyebrow "Gift cards", H2 "Can't pick for them? Let them pick.", text "Advent Games gift cards are digital, land in their inbox straight away, and work on every game, expansion and preorder on the site." Button "Buy a gift card" to the native gift card product.

### 10. Seasonal campaign · Image banner · `tweak`
Background `site/design/img/sale-bg.jpg`. White text panel: orange pill "Up to 40% off · 26 Dec to 5 Jan", H2 "Boxing Day sale starts 26 December", text "Up to 40% off selected games, expansions and accessories. While stocks last.", buttons "Set a reminder" (primary) and "See last year's picks" (secondary). **Tweak:** corner "Sale on" ribbon and the pill (CSS). One campaign at a time.

### 11. Shop by publisher · Logo list · `native`
"Shop by publisher" / "All brands A-Z". 8 logos, full colour, in bordered tiles (8 across desktop, 2 on mobile): `site/design/img/pub/` gmt.png, stonemaier.png, lookout.png, cge.svg, daysofwonder.png, capstone.png, pegasus.svg, riogrande.svg. Each links to its vendor collection (or `#` until it exists).

### 12. Brand story · Media with text · `tweak`
Image left (`site/design/img/story.jpg`, Torvi the staffy watching Lost Cities). Brand-blue tint band (#e8eef8). Eyebrow "About Advent Games", H2 "Your friendly, local, online board game store", text "Owner-operated in Sydney since 2012, with a huge range, fair prices and the hard-to-find games other stores don't carry. Ask about a game, a preorder or an order you've already placed and you'll hear back from Dean, not an AI response." Buttons "Our story" (primary), "Pickup & shipping" (secondary). **Tweak:** decorative floating game-piece icons in the band background (CSS/SVG, low opacity). Flag: "since 2012" isn't confirmed by Dean.

### 13. What our customers say · Google Reviews app · `custom`
The app isn't installed yet. Add a placeholder (Testimonials section with the 3 example quotes from the design, or skip) and note it in your report. "Leave us a review" link is still an open question.

Then the footer group (newsletter, footer).

## Cart drawer (part of the home page test, since Add to cart is on the cards)
Enterprise native drawer: View cart link + close at the top, free shipping bar as an **inset rounded card** (#e8eef8, radius 10), line items with availability line, order note and estimate shipping accordions, "You may also like" slider (complementary products), promo banner at the bottom ("New to preorder"). **Tweak:** sticky footer with Subtotal, "Tax included. Shipping and pickup chosen at checkout." and the main button **"Checkout · $total"** in orange, going straight to `/checkout` (theme default is "View cart"). Check for a theme setting first. No payment icons in the drawer.

## Done means
- Every section above exists on the dev theme in this order, with the content and settings listed.
- Side-by-side screenshots of the dev theme preview against the design at **1440px and 390px** look like the same page. Small differences that come from Enterprise's native layout are fine; list them.
- No edits to Enterprise's own files apart from the `advent.css` include, plus any Liquid tweak that's explicitly listed here.
- A short report: what's done, what's flagged, what's missing (collections, menus, images, app), and the preview link.
